item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q007_chey_like_function_divergence","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08 the supported relationship is superfamily-level, not merely a shared broad fold: CheY-related response regulators are family c.23.1.1, the ornithine-decarboxylase N-terminal wing is family c.23.1.4, and the KaiA N-terminal domain is family c.23.1.5; all three are sibling families in the CheY-like superfamily c.23.1, SUNID 52172, under the Flavodoxin-like fold c.23 in the alpha/beta class c. That placement supports remote CheY-like homology across diverged families, while keeping each named group in a separate family. It does not make the ODC wing or KaiA N-terminal domain canonical two-component receiver domains; SCOPe annotates the KaiA N-terminal family as lacking canonical receiver-domain features. Conversely, CheY-related receiver domains and KaiA N-terminal domains should not be assigned ornithine-decarboxylase PLP catalytic activity just because the ODC N-terminal wing belongs to the same CheY-like superfamily. The SCOPe family and superfamily nodes are curated classification evidence; no AlphaFold hit, PDB-chain representative fallback, or single template was needed, and the shared superfamily should not be used to transfer exact active-site residues, phosphorylation/Mg2+ signaling chemistry, substrate specificity, quaternary state, or domain boundaries among the three families without separate sequence or structural evidence.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope.get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.23.1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.23.1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52172; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52172/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52172/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52172/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52173; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52173/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52173/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52173/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52252; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52252/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52252/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52252/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/82344; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/82344/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/82344/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/82344/annotations","mcp__scope.list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.23.1/children?limit=100","mcp__scope.list_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/domains?limit=25&sccs_prefix=c.23.1.1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/domains?limit=25&sccs_prefix=c.23.1.4; /api/v1/releases/2.08/domains?limit=25&sccs_prefix=c.23.1.5"]}]}
